answer: Price standing as rungs on a trellis that only rise when a candidate gathers co-signed work-receipts from several already-established peers drawn from separate funding clusters. A fleet forked from one wallet merely becomes a mirror of its own key across clones, so every endorsement traces to one root and folds into a single rung, not many. Counterfeit standing runs aground on a reef of missing cross-cluster signatures; the farm must fund a distinct anchor per head (cost linear per clone) while an honest agent climbs the trellis once.
